name: rg
description: ripgrep — fast recursive search tool respecting .gitignore

args.name: path
args.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

flags.name: --type
flags.description: Search only files matching this type (e.g. rust, py, js)

flags.name: --glob
flags.description: Include or exclude files matching this glob pattern

flags.name: --hidden
flags.description: Search hidden files and directories

flags.name: --no-ignore
flags.description: Do not respect .gitignore and similar files

flags.name: --case-sensitive
flags.description: Search case-sensitively

flags.name: --ignore-case
flags.description: Search case-insensitively

flags.name: --smart-case
flags.description: Case-insensitive if pattern is lowercase, otherwise sensitive

flags.name: --fixed-strings
flags.description: Treat pattern as literal string, not regex

flags.name: --line-number
flags.description: Show line numbers (default in terminal)

flags.name: --column
flags.description: Show column numbers

flags.name: --count
flags.description: Show count of matching lines per file

flags.name: --files-with-matches
flags.description: Print only filenames with matches

flags.name: --files-without-match
flags.description: Print only filenames with no matches

flags.name: --word-regexp
flags.description: Match only whole words

flags.name: --multiline
flags.description: Enable multiline matching

flags.name: --context
flags.description: Show NUM lines before and after each match

flags.name: --before-context
flags.description: Show NUM lines before each match

flags.name: --after-context
flags.description: Show NUM lines after each match

flags.name: --max-depth
flags.description: Limit search depth in directory traversal

flags.name: --max-count
flags.description: Stop after NUM matches per file

flags.name: --follow
flags.description: Follow symbolic links

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Output results in JSON format

flags.name: --replace
flags.description: Replace each match with the given text in output

flags.name: --only-matching
flags.description: Print only the matched parts of each matching line
